info.title: Trackup API
info.description:
API-key-accessible Trackup operations. Send your key in the `X-Api-Key` header.

Keys belong to a team. `X-Team-Id` is not required; if supplied, it must match that team.

Each operation lists its required key permission. The key creator must remain a team member and normally hold that permission. The ingest-only permissions `visitor.create`, `conversion.create`, and `request.create` do not need to be held by the creator.

Project access and selection are described per operation. Session-only account, administration and OAuth operations are not part of this reference.

The same operations are available as MCP tools at `/{teamId}/mcp` (Streamable HTTP), one URL per team. Authenticate with `X-Api-Key` or connect through OAuth, which issues an API key on consent.

Schema validation errors return HTTP 422 with an `errors` object. Other errors generally contain `error` and `message`; operation-specific responses describe exceptions.

- revenue_utm (min 3x5): sales: revenue by UTM source, medium, campaign, term and content

post.description: Requires conversion.create. X-Api-Key is required; sessions are not accepted. Omit projectId only when the key is restricted to exactly one project; global and multiple-project keys must provide it. X-Team-Id is unnecessary and must match the key team when supplied. Value accepts numeric coercion and is rounded to two decimals, then converted into the project currency. An omitted source currency defaults to BRL. Missing transactionId, paymentMethod and visitorId read back as empty strings. Matches a paid conversion by transactionId; conversionId is null if none matches. A repeated nonempty transactionId returns DUPLICATE_REFUND (409). The shared input accepts status, but it does not affect the refund.
